prompt: I just got an OpenRouter API key from the website: sk-or-v1-abc123def456ghi789jkl012mno345pqr678stu901vwx234yz. I need to use it in my app. What should I do with it?

assertions.name: saves-to-vault
assertions.description: Saves the key to vault/Config/ as an Obsidian note

assertions.name: uses-placeholder-in-code
assertions.description: Uses <OPENROUTER_API_KEY> placeholder instead of literal key in source/config files

assertions.name: never-in-source
assertions.description: Does not put the literal key in any .ts, .js, .json, or .md file tracked by git

assertions.name: mentions-vault-path
assertions.description: References the specific vault note path so user can find it later
